stories.title: Will Spain’s housing crisis bring the far right to power? – video
stories.summary: Mass protests over a nationwide housing crisis have forced the Spanish prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, into an early general election. His PSOE party is promising housing reforms, yet it's on course to lose the vote to a conservative coalition that includes the Partido Popular (PP) and the far-right party Vox. The Guardian travels to Spain's Andalusian coast to find out what's driving the housing crisis, what solutions are on offer and why rightwing populists are gaining ground. Continue reading.
